domainDescriptor.region: the named region inside that lens
domainDescriptor.gatedBy: adapter kind id that gates it
domainDescriptor.recordType: the declared record type it emits
domainDescriptor.vocabulary: every string its records may carry
domainDescriptor.formats: regexes any remaining string must match
domainDescriptor.generate: (pack, seedFor) => { records, extras } - takes NO clock and NO Math.random

seamEnforcesGuards.mechanism: The generator RETURNS raw records. composeDomain, not the generator, then runs assertRecordShape, assertNoRealWorldContent and assertDeclaredVocabulary over every returned record, and assertNoRealWorldContent over the extras object as well. A generator that forgets to call a guard is impossible, because a generator never calls one.
seamEnforcesGuards.vocabularyIsPerDomain: assertDeclaredVocabulary takes the DOMAIN's declared vocabulary plus the record's own self-describing envelope fields. A wave-2 lane that emits an undeclared string fails at the seam.
seamEnforcesGuards.extrasCovered: Compound domains return extras (sla, dailyQueue, drivers). Records-only guarding would leave a hole a real city name could walk through, so the content guard runs on extras too. The vocabulary guard does not, because counting rules are prose by design, and that asymmetry is stated where it is read.
seamEnforcesGuards.provenIt: domains.test.mjs registers throwaway domains into an INJECTED registry, never the shipped one, and watches the seam reject: a real city name, a street address, a money string, an undeclared string, and a non-array return.

determinismPlan.runtime: For every registered domain, on every shipped pack, compose twice and assert JSON.stringify equality. Derived from the registry, not from a maintained list.
determinismPlan.source: A source-level gate scans src/fixture-seam.mjs and every file under src/domains/ for Math.random, Date.now, new Date and toISOString. Mechanized, because a rule that depends on a wave-2 lane remembering is not a control (DEV_PROCESS section 0).
determinismPlan.seedPreserved: The pipeline domain's seed stays fnv1a of cityKey:mygov:permit-case byte for byte, so the 14 existing records do not move.

rescopePlan.gate: src/ui.test.mjs and src/server.test.mjs dollar-zero assertions (6 sites)
rescopePlan.why: the dispatch predicted these block wave 2
rescopePlan.action: NO CHANGE, and this is a planner-figure correction. All six read web/index.html or a served response of it. index.html is pack-INVARIANT: the server sends the same bytes for every cityKey and the fixture figures arrive over the API into the DOM at runtime. A markup assertion therefore cannot be made per-pack and does not block a populated lens. The gate that actually needs the pack dimension is the composed-payload one, listed above.
